title: Coast Guard medevacs 40-year-old woman near Ocean Cay
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Miami MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew hoists a 40-year-old woman from the cruise ship, MSC Seaside, May 25, 2020 near Ocean Cay, Bahamas. Coast Guard 7th District watchstanders received a medevac request from the MSC Seaside crew due to a 40-year-old woman experiencing pregnancy complications and launched a Coast Guard Air Station Miami MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew who arrived on scene, hoisted the patient and brought her to emergency medical services ashore. (Coast Guard Video)
keywords: hoist, MH-65 Dolphin helicopter, Air Station Miami, District 7, Coast Guard, medevac, Florida, Cruise Ship
